create_image_regression_params: create an ImageRegressionParams instance with custom learning rate and batch size for training
configure_image_regression_model: configure ImageRegressionParams to use a different Vision Transformer model from Hugging Face
set_early_stopping_params: set early stopping patience and threshold on ImageRegressionParams to prevent overfitting
enable_mixed_precision_training: enable fp16 or bf16 mixed precision on ImageRegressionParams for faster training
configure_hub_push_params: configure ImageRegressionParams with username and token to push trained model to Hugging Face Hub
